# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class ToggleGroup < Base
    SPACING_GAP = {0 => nil, 1 => "gap-1", 2 => "gap-2", 3 => "gap-3", 4 => "gap-4"}.freeze
    VALID_TYPES = [:single, :multiple].freeze
    VALID_ORIENTATIONS = [:horizontal, :vertical].freeze

    def initialize(
      type: :single,
      name: nil,
      value: nil,
      variant: :default,
      size: :default,
      disabled: false,
      spacing: 2,
      orientation: :horizontal,
      loop_focus: true,
      **attrs
    )
      @type = type.to_sym
      raise ArgumentError, "type must be :single or :multiple" unless VALID_TYPES.include?(@type)

      @orientation = orientation.to_sym
      raise ArgumentError, "orientation must be :horizontal or :vertical" unless VALID_ORIENTATIONS.include?(@orientation)

      raise ArgumentError, "spacing must be an Integer 0..4" unless spacing.is_a?(Integer) && (0..4).cover?(spacing)

      @name = name
      @value = value
      @variant = variant.to_sym
      @size = size.to_sym
      @disabled = disabled
      @spacing = spacing
      @loop_focus = loop_focus
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      div(**attrs) do
        yield(self)
        render_hidden_inputs
      end
    end

    def item_context
      {
        type: @type,
        variant: @variant,
        size: @size,
        disabled: @disabled,
        selected_values: selected_values,
        spacing: @spacing,
        orientation: @orientation
      }
    end

    def ToggleGroupItem(**kwargs, &block)
      render RubyUI::ToggleGroupItem.new(group_context: item_context, **kwargs), &block
    end

    private

    def selected_values
      case @type
      when :single then @value.nil? ? [] : [@value.to_s]
      when :multiple then Array(@value).map(&:to_s)
      end
    end

    def render_hidden_inputs
      return unless @name

      if @type == :single
        input(
          type: "hidden",
          name: @name,
          value: selected_values.first.to_s,
          data: {"ruby-ui--toggle-group-target": "input"}
        )
      else
        selected_values.each do |v|
          input(
            type: "hidden",
            name: "#{@name}[]",
            value: v,
            data: {"ruby-ui--toggle-group-target": "input"}
          )
        end
      end
    end

    def default_attrs
      data = {
        slot: "toggle-group",
        variant: @variant.to_s,
        size: @size.to_s,
        spacing: @spacing.to_s,
        orientation: @orientation.to_s,
        controller: "ruby-ui--toggle-group",
        "ruby-ui--toggle-group-type-value": @type.to_s,
        "ruby-ui--toggle-group-name-value": @name.to_s,
        "ruby-ui--toggle-group-orientation-value": @orientation.to_s,
        "ruby-ui--toggle-group-loop-focus-value": @loop_focus.to_s
      }
      data[:multiple] = "" if @type == :multiple
      data[:disabled] = "" if @disabled

      {role: "group", data: data, class: container_classes}
    end

    def container_classes
      base = if @orientation == :vertical
        "flex w-fit flex-col items-stretch rounded-md"
      else
        "flex w-fit flex-row items-center rounded-md"
      end

      [
        base,
        SPACING_GAP[@spacing],
        (@spacing == 0 && @variant == :outline) ? "shadow-xs" : nil
      ].compact
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class ToggleGroupItem < Toggle
    JOIN_BASE = "shrink-0 focus:z-10 focus-visible:z-10 data-[state=on]:bg-muted"
    # Joined groups (spacing 0): vega's cn-toggle-group-item padding and corners.
    JOINED = "rounded-none shadow-none px-2 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5"

    def initialize(value:, group_context:, variant: nil, size: nil, **attrs)
      @item_value = value.to_s
      @group_context = group_context

      pressed = group_context[:selected_values].include?(@item_value)
      super(
        pressed: pressed,
        name: nil,
        value: @item_value,
        variant: variant || group_context[:variant],
        size: size || group_context[:size],
        disabled: group_context[:disabled],
        **attrs
      )
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      button(**attrs, &block)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      attrs = {type: "button", aria: {pressed: @pressed.to_s}, tabindex: initial_tabindex}
      attrs[:disabled] = true if @disabled

      data = {
        slot: "toggle-group-item",
        variant: @variant.to_s,
        size: @size.to_s,
        spacing: @group_context[:spacing].to_s,
        state: @pressed ? "on" : "off",
        value: @item_value,
        "ruby-ui--toggle-group-target": "item",
        action: "click->ruby-ui--toggle-group#select keydown->ruby-ui--toggle-group#navigate"
      }
      data[:pressed] = "" if @pressed
      data[:disabled] = "" if @disabled
      attrs[:data] = data
      attrs[:class] = [Toggle.classes_for(variant: @variant, size: @size), join_classes]
      attrs
    end

    # One tab stop per group: a pressed item when there is a selection, every
    # item until the controller connects otherwise (it then keeps only one).
    def initial_tabindex
      return "0" if @group_context[:selected_values].empty?

      @pressed ? "0" : "-1"
    end

    def join_classes
      classes = [JOIN_BASE]
      return classes unless @group_context[:spacing] == 0

      classes << JOINED
      if @group_context[:orientation] == :vertical
        classes << "first-of-type:rounded-t-md last-of-type:rounded-b-md"
        classes << "border-t-0 first-of-type:border-t" if @variant == :outline
      else
        classes << "first-of-type:rounded-l-md last-of-type:rounded-r-md"
        classes << "border-l-0 first-of-type:border-l" if @variant == :outline
      end
      classes
    end
  end
end
